notes: All 50 complete blinded source reports personally read in five groups of ten. All 600 target states, exact contiguous quotations and notes explicitly reasoned from these sources. No batch057 draft/review/preread/flags or official gold/legacy annotations inspected. Scripts assembled explicit decisions and checked quotations, schema, UID membership and hashes only; no regex/NLI/automatic inference/default filling. Source defects, uncertainty, qualifiers, anatomy, extent and acuity remain preserved. A named ICRS grade in index040 was checked against the original ICRS evaluation publication, with the external primary reference recorded below; no unkeyed grading convention was assumed or frozen-rubric change made. Unfinished files stayed outside initiative and this complete draft requires separate independent source review. These are weak report-derived labels, not image diagnostic rereads.

primary_references.title: ICRS Cartilage Injury Evaluation Package
primary_references.publisher: International Cartilage Regeneration & Joint Preservation Society
primary_references.verified_fact: ICRS Grade 2 describes lesions reaching less than50% of cartilage depth.
primary_references.use: Below-threshold depth only for the report that explicitly names ICRS; not transferred to unkeyed gradeII reports.

flags.issue: Unfilled NC/NA grades/sequences, malformed intact-number measurements and isolated0 fields preserved without parsing or repair.
Very sparse reports: Hoffa-only013 has all12 targets unmentioned; medial-meniscal-tear-only032 has just that target positive. Silence never filled negative.
Source conflicts: direct small partial medial tear versus nonsurfacing grade2a description; direct bone bruise versus no bone contusion. Conflicting targets remain masked.
Uncomplicated/normal-variant discoid meniscus versus rubric abnormal morphology is unresolved for021/027. Case044 has definite bucket-handle tear and is positive independently of congenital shape.

Meniscal morphology/anatomy: degeneration plus extrusion ambiguous006; inner/outer names swapped between headings025 but both explicitly intact; lateral marginal amputation041 supports abnormal morphology. No silent anatomy repair.

Moderate fluid uses literal subarticular wording in a joint/suprapatellar context; effusion interpretation flagged. Synovial fatty metaplasia/possible early lipoma arborescens does not establish inflamed thickened lining.
Partial or absent assessment of whole cartilage/marrow compartments and anterior heading that only describes patellar height are not filled from silence. Review explicit scope and masked values.
Cartilage severity/depth versus extent, low-grade descriptions, qualified negative statements, and focal high-grade lesions require source-specific review; no automatic OA/numbered-grade positives.
Fracture acuity, probable traumatic trabecular impaction and impact-related marrow interpretation remain source-specific. No blanket subtype mapping or automatic transfer from earlier bone audits.
Dutch laterale banden ambiguity for MCL; both remain masked rather than assume plural lateral structures mean all collaterals.
Moderate suprapatellar distension conflicts with minimal hydrops conclusion, effusion masked; directly diagnosed chronic synovitis remains positive.
Incompletely graded OA, generic ACL tear fraction, nonspecific bone changes and garbled anatomy preserved; original wording is not automatically corrected.
Baker dimensions without adopted clinical severity category remain masked; small/moderate range in effusion likewise crosses threshold.
Nondiagnostic refers only to scout localizers, not the complete diagnostic examination. No report exclusion or automatic quality downgrade.
